name: 大话西游 (A Chinese Odyssey)
english_name: A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You)
english_description: The original archive was labeled "Wuhan Station," but that's just a collector's site tag — the game's own config and login banner identify its true name as A Chinese Odyssey (Da Hua Xi You), themed after the beloved Stephen Chow film, and run by the Xiangfan branch of Hubei's Chutian Hotline network. It belongs to the ES II (Eastern Stories II) engine family, sharing lineage with this collection's wmkj and tiexuejianghu, though each was developed independently. New characters start at the South City Inn, greeted by a newbie counselor, a waiter, and a courier NPC, and register with a separate recovery PIN kept apart from the login password. A real sect system lets characters petition to join General Qin's Mansion once their combat experience clears a genuine threshold, and killing weak civilian NPCs for coin is a working income path for shop purchases. Deep playtesting uncovered a notable driver-API-misuse crash — calling enable_commands() from an NPC's init() instead of create() reentrantly re-triggers that NPC's own init(), crashing a room's very first visit — which recurred identically across 28 sect-succession NPCs sharing the same "神话世界·西游记" template inherited from this codebase, and was flagged as a risk for roughly 60 other libs in this collection built on the same template.
